qualification.en: This is a statement about access in California. It does not discuss protection of life from conception or a gestational limit.

quote: ensure uninterrupted, equitable access to contraception, abortion, and maternal health support.

sourceTitle.en: Xavier Becerra for Governor 2026, Health Care page, last updated August 16, 2026

summary.en: The health-care page says that on day one he would direct state agencies to protect access to reproductive care, including contraception, abortion, and maternal health support, from federal restrictions.
